newsitem.title: DENMARK: Copenhagen Airport H1 traffic up 6.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen Airport H1 traffic up 6.2 pct.

text.p: Passenger volume at Copenhagen International Airport rose 6.2 percent to 8.2 million in the first six months of 1997, airport statistics issued on Thursday showed.
In 1996 passenger traffic totalled 16.1 million, 7.3 percent up on the previous year.
In its last annual report, Copenhagen Airports forecast that passenger volume would reach 17 million for the whole of 1997.
Copenhagen International Airport is Europe's tenth biggest as regards passenger volume.
